descriptions.M01: Loop runs one step too many or too few. Wrong belief: `i<=n` (from 0) runs n times; whether the bound is the last value included or excluded is mixed up
descriptions.M02: Loop variable never moves toward the exit. Wrong belief: The loop variable advances by itself and the loop ends by itself
descriptions.M03: Running total is reset inside the loop. Wrong belief: The total keeps its value across passes even if it is set again inside the loop
descriptions.M04: int ÷ int drops the decimals. Wrong belief: int / int gives the exact decimal
descriptions.M05: Variable used before it was given a value. Wrong belief: Local variables start at 0
descriptions.M06: `=` stores a value; `==` compares. Wrong belief: `=` compares
descriptions.M07: A stray `;` gives the if/loop an empty body. Wrong belief: A `;` after the header is harmless
descriptions.M08: Arrays start at 0; last cell is n−1. Wrong belief: Arrays are indexed 1..n
descriptions.M10: `printf` shows a value; `return` hands it back. Wrong belief: Printing the value hands it back to the caller
descriptions.D01: The search gives up after the first miss. Wrong belief: The else branch means 'not this one, keep looking'; it doesn't end or overwrite anything
descriptions.D02: Binary search window never shrinks (`low = mid`). Wrong belief: mid is excluded from the window automatically
descriptions.D03: Swapping without a temp loses a value. Wrong belief: Two assignments happen at the same time
descriptions.D04: One pass doesn't sort the whole array. Wrong belief: One pass over the array sorts it
descriptions.D05: Recursion has no reachable base case. Wrong belief: Recursion stops by itself when the work is done
descriptions.D06: The recursive call doesn't move toward the base case. Wrong belief: The recursive call moves toward the base case on its own
descriptions.D07: The recursive call's result is thrown away. Wrong belief: The recursive call's result is combined automatically
descriptions.D08: `==` doesn't compare text in C. Wrong belief: `==` compares text
descriptions.CORRECT_REASON: Correct reasoning: the explanation matches how C really behaves.
